visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of a film strip being pulled from a Kodak photo machine, followed by a wide shot of a man in an orange t-shirt and a woman in a white t-shirt and black shorts dancing enthusiastically. They are in a brightly lit shopping mall corridor in front of a massive yellow and red installation shaped like a Kodak ColorPlus film box. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a retail space with light wood shelving and bright yellow accents. The characters explore the store, touching various items of clothing including t-shirts and caps displayed on racks. A large black Kodak film canister prop stands near the entrance. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of the merchandise: colorful hats on shelves, vintage-style cameras, and a variety of bags and accessories. The lighting is crisp and even, highlighting the textures of the fabric and the glossy finishes of the products. (4) The characters are shown interacting with mirrors and a retro-themed corner featuring a stack of old televisions and yellow branding. They take pictures in a Kodak-branded photo booth and show off a printed photo strip. (5) The final segment focuses on promotional items like film canister keychains and yellow shopping bags. The duo stands in front of the large film box prop again, waving and holding up the items to the camera as variety-style text overlays appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a vibrant, high-tempo electronic beat characterized by bright synth chords and a driving 4/4 rhythm. A male voice begins an energetic narration in Traditional Chinese, speaking with a professional yet enthusiastic tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the first visual cut. The narrator describes the location and opening dates. The music remains steady, providing a high-energy background bed. (3) A digital UI 'pop' SFX is heard as text bubbles appear on screen. The narrator's pitch rises when mentioning the 'retro photo sticker machine'. (4) A mechanical camera shutter click SFX is integrated into the mix during the photo booth montage. The background music maintains its tempo, with no significant harmonic tension changes. (5) As the promotional gifts are listed, multiple quick 'ding' effects accompany the text overlays. The narration concludes with a high-arousal invitation to visit the store, followed by a final rhythmic beat and a clean fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Store Exploration -> Product Showcase -> Incentive/Giveaway Details -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to announce and market the Kodak pop-up shop at Shin Kong Mitsukoshi A11 in Taipei. It aims to generate excitement among young consumers by showcasing 'retro-functional' apparel, unique photo-taking experiences, and limited-edition promotional gifts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the store location, specific product lines, pricing for giveaways, and verbal invitation to visit.
